consultation.designer: Approved common fallback pool, including ordinary outbound staging/loading via existing Dispatch owner. Explicit facility/crew commitments first; current safe work retained; skip blocked higher categories. Initial order unloading, dispatch, construction, production, other.

owners.staffing: Rear retains exclusive actor phases, assignments, safe handoff and existing bounded settle transaction. In empty-field sessions a fallback Hauling request consumes only workers remaining after explicit compatible staffing quotas.
owners.preference: Small scene-owned HaulingPolicy validates a complete permutation of five stable category IDs. It classifies existing haul destinations and invokes existing owners at an idle selection boundary. No polling, new clock or generic job framework.
owners.unloading: Receiving retains four finite handling opportunities per berth,25kg source/destination claims and actual walk/pickup/carry/drop. Shared worker entries retire after completion before selecting next category; dedicated legacy staff retain existing behavior.

owners.ui: A feature-local priority list edits only a local draft using Godot Control drag/drop; one explicit command applies validated priorities and then settles. Existing menu-discard/session-bind clears draft.

boundaries: Arrival is physical before actor discovery/allocation. Four opening workers use fallback Hauling. Existing explicit staff requests preempt fallback without duplicating people; carrying/pending handoffs preserve safe completion.
Top-first means next feasible category, then existing within-category urgency/distance/order. In-progress work is unchanged by reorder. Blocked top category does not prevent lower work.
Receiving shared entries never autostart a second task and bypass priority; cleanup synchronizes actual Rear actor. Four active slots per berth are counted from actual jobs, not visual presence.

Dispatch shared preparation must approach source/staged store before handling. New work points use the same physical access owner as unloading; no stock/carrier teleport. General dispatch readiness can use actual common haulers with a complete usable Logistics Centre.

Cancelled/changed manifests retain existing safe task policy. A pending staffing reassignment cannot take a second task. Pause stops existing timing; preference edits may occur paused or with no current workers. Hidden menus do no recurring scheduling.

Drag carries owner/category IDs; wrong-owner or stale IDs are rejected. Outside/Escape drag does not change draft. Confirm validates full permutation; stale model replacement discards old draft. Live state changes do not reorder controls mid-edit.
